ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
DataLab-Capsule is the neutral provenance and exchange layer of the DataLab open-source platform.
It records, packages and verifies the processing history of scientific workspaces as capsules
(`.dlcapsule`): ZIP archives holding the HDF5 workspace and an RO-Crate 1.3 manifest conforming to
Process Run Crate 0.6 and to the DataLab capsule profile. It provides integrity primitives (canonical
JSON, SHA-256 digests, signal and image state fingerprints), semantic diff, verification without
computation, revisions and reviews, and a `workspace-capsule` command line. The core needs only
`jsonschema`: install NumPy and h5py to create capsules or check stored states, and FastAPI and
uvicorn to run a capsule registry. It never imports DataLab, Sigima or Qt.
about.summary: Exchange and verify scientific workspace provenance as open RO-Crate capsules (library and CLI, no DataLab required).

name: datalab-capsule
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.0"

package:
  name: datalab-capsule
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/d/datalab_capsule/datalab_capsule-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 70a9f562d1dd525635f89a65c8ab77b32caa669f4b123f84bfc73e505459f0dd

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - workspace-capsule = datalab_capsule.cli:main
      - workspace-capsule-registry = datalab_capsule.cli:registry_main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - jsonschema >=4.17
  run_constraints:
    # Optional features, as the "hdf5" and "registry" extras on PyPI
    - numpy >=1.22
    - h5py >=3.6
    - fastapi >=0.110
    - uvicorn >=0.27

tests:
  # For noarch Python packages, conda-forge checks both the minimum and the
  # latest supported Python
  - python:
      imports:
        - datalab_capsule
        - datalab_capsule.cli
        - datalab_capsule.exchange
        - datalab_capsule.inspection
        - datalab_capsule.recorder
        - datalab_capsule.registry_client
        - datalab_capsule.verify
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  # The core package reads capsules without NumPy, h5py or FastAPI
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/fixtures/corpus/valid/chain-desktop.dlcapsule
        - tests/fixtures/corpus/valid/chain-web.dlcapsule
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - workspace-capsule --help
      - workspace-capsule validate tests/fixtures/corpus/valid/chain-desktop.dlcapsule
      - workspace-capsule inspect tests/fixtures/corpus/valid/chain-web.dlcapsule
      # Exits with 1 when the capsules differ
      - workspace-capsule diff tests/fixtures/corpus/valid/chain-desktop.dlcapsule tests/fixtures/corpus/valid/chain-desktop.dlcapsule
  # Full test suite, with the optional dependencies
  - files:
      source:
        - pyproject.toml
        - tests/
        - examples/
        - benchmarks/
        - scripts/
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pytest >=7
        - numpy >=1.22
        - h5py >=3.6
        - httpx >=0.27
        - fastapi >=0.110
        - uvicorn >=0.27
    script:
      - pytest -v tests

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/DataLab-Platform/DataLab-Capsule
  summary: Exchange and verify scientific workspace provenance as open RO-Crate capsules (library and CLI, no DataLab required).
  description: |
    DataLab-Capsule is the neutral provenance and exchange layer of the DataLab open-source platform.
    It records, packages and verifies the processing history of scientific workspaces as capsules
    (`.dlcapsule`): ZIP archives holding the HDF5 workspace and an RO-Crate 1.3 manifest conforming to
    Process Run Crate 0.6 and to the DataLab capsule profile. It provides integrity primitives (canonical
    JSON, SHA-256 digests, signal and image state fingerprints), semantic diff, verification without
    computation, revisions and reviews, and a `workspace-capsule` command line. The core needs only
    `jsonschema`: install NumPy and h5py to create capsules or check stored states, and FastAPI and
    uvicorn to run a capsule registry. It never imports DataLab, Sigima or Qt.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/DataLab-Platform/DataLab-Capsule

extra:

    - PierreRaybaut
